parsed.note_claim: King Charles had his Lord Chamberlain issue a letter enforcing the Sandringham Agreement, and the Sussexes are private citizens who are not working royals.

parsed.quote: They will still not be able to use titles of "His and Her Royal Highness", and remain "private citizens", says the letter sent on behalf of the King by the Lord Chamberlain, a top Palace official.
